bug_semantics: OliveTin separately authorizes action execution and access to action logs. A caller with exec:true and logs:false can invoke the synchronous StartActionAndWait or StartActionByGetAndWait RPC; each vulnerable handler waits for execution, retrieves its InternalLogEntry, converts it to the protobuf LogEntry (including stdout/stderr-derived Output and execution metadata), and returns it without the logs authorization used by GetLogs, GetActionLogs, ExecutionStatus, and EventStream. This is a post-execution authorization bypass and confidentiality disclosure, not an execution-ACL bypass.
flaw_origin: The vulnerable synchronous response pattern was first authored in PR #188 member commit c921595a365d75e845d75321eefae76290b53874: StartActionAndWait and the ancestor of StartActionByGetAndWait (then StartActionByAliasAndWait) directly returned internalLogEntryToPb after waiting. GitHub squash commit d0f74c1ab74fd8e1d198dc1a6f9a2b87b573bd82 published the same change; 381bf59fbd79e8a122bf3b4052789863c86d89f5 later renamed/refactored the alias route to StartActionByGetAndWait without adding authorization, and a62d58f11955fe192f45da13e23ba996a2759404 merely moved the implementation from grpcapi to api. The confidentiality gap became exercisable when db5de9be9793be65e2a77ab71656713f97bc779b added independent Logs permission and enforced it on GetLogs but left both synchronous return paths unchanged.
ai_marker: Absent on BIC commit object c921595a365d75e845d75321eefae76290b53874. `git cat-file -p c921595a365d75e845d75321eefae76290b53874` shows author and committer `jamesread <contact@jread.com>` and the sole message `feature: Additional APIs for StartAction`, with no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, AI tool trailer, or bot identity. The Cursor co-author trailer exists only on the 2026 direct fix and is excluded by the BIC-only rule.
evidence: Advisory GHSA-jm28-2wcr-qf3h / CVE-2026-67439 names both synchronous endpoints, declares vulnerable `< 0.0.0-20260708085316-e421780c9885`, first patched `0.0.0-20260708085316-e421780c9885`, and references e421780c9885aa5024d2f47b4ed4898f2f18eb90 and release 3000.17.0. Reproduce provenance in the validated clone: (1) `git log --all --reverse -S'StartActionAndWait' -- '*.go' '*.proto'` first finds squash d0f74c1ab74fd8e1d198dc1a6f9a2b87b573bd82; `git log -L 53,77:internal/grpcapi/grpcApi.go c921595a365d75e845d75321eefae76290b53874` attributes the complete waiting/direct-LogEntry return handler to c921595a365d75e845d75321eefae76290b53874. The analogous `git log -L 109,146:internal/grpcapi/grpcApi.go c921595a365d75e845d75321eefae76290b53874` attributes StartActionByAliasAndWait, the route later renamed StartActionByGetAndWait, to the same commit. (2) GitHub's first-party PR endpoint `https://api.github.com/repos/OliveTin/OliveTin/pulls/188/commits` lists authoring member c921595a365d75e845d75321eefae76290b53874 followed only by merge-from-main 9598c0fead4c930b1d14d488c0d5d201b67c21bc; the latter and squash d0f74c1 have tree ab83f6c599111e018be25415c5577dbacda1aad8, establishing squash decomposition. (3) `git grep -n -E 'StartActionAndWait|StartActionByAliasAndWait' 3b60bbce0adc51cc0a5c82f8483d0361286c7f0e -- '*.go' '*.proto'` returns no matches, while the same command at c921595a365d75e845d75321eefae76290b53874 finds both RPC definitions and handlers; direct parent absence is therefore verified. (4) `git show db5de9be9793be65e2a77ab71656713f97bc779b -- internal/config/config.go internal/acl/acl.go internal/grpcapi/grpcApi.go` shows addition of PermissionsList.Logs and IsAllowedLogs plus enforcement in GetLogs, while the synchronous handlers remain direct returns; `git tag --contains db5de9be9793be65e2a77ab71656713f97bc779b --sort=creatordate` begins at 2024.04.18. (5) Before the fix, `git grep -n 'LogEntry: api.internalLogEntryToPb' 995ff79736f2bccc364448a3ece84087b550b232 -- service/internal/api/api.go` finds the unguarded returns at lines 303 and 355. `git show 904616b1b1ef995ab868431b0835cb3fc368be7b` adds requireLogEntryAllowed, routes both handlers through it, and tests permission denial; e421780c9885aa5024d2f47b4ed4898f2f18eb90 merges that direct fix, and `git diff --exit-code 904616b1b1ef995ab868431b0835cb3fc368be7b e421780c9885aa5024d2f47b4ed4898f2f18eb90 -- service/internal/api/api.go service/internal/api/api_test.go` is empty. (6) `git rev-parse 3000.16.2 3000.17.0` yields 5bcbdb40855218861a22d10c37c69ad89d2c65e6 and d0075a7a8d44028793ea3384b34062b940841f24; `git merge-base --is-ancestor e421780c9885aa5024d2f47b4ed4898f2f18eb90 3000.16.2` fails and the same check against 3000.17.0 succeeds, proving the release boundary. (7) `git cat-file -p c921595a365d75e845d75321eefae76290b53874` reproduces the BIC-only human identity and absence of AI attribution.
reasoning: The minimal authored origin is the PR member commit, not its GitHub squash, the later endpoint rename, the grpc-to-Connect migration, or the fix merge. Its parent contains neither synchronous RPC, and its patch creates both wait-and-return implementations with the sensitive LogEntry conversion but no read authorization. The later logs-permission commit supplies the security invariant that makes those pre-existing response paths exploitable; it does not write the vulnerable return lines and therefore belongs in the lifecycle rather than replacing the smallest BIC. The direct fix applies the existing logs ACL to both response paths and the mainline merge is exactly the advisory's patched pseudo-version boundary. Because the decomposed BIC commit object is human-authored and contains no qualifying AI marker, the only supportable verdict is NOT_AI; Cursor attribution on the fix cannot affect that verdict.
